PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Clara's clue ("She was beside the table in the Art Room."). So Clara (C) must be at row 2, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Clara crossed out, only one square is left for Dinah that fits her clue ("She was beside the speaker."). So Dinah (D) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Clara and Dinah crossed out, only one square is left for Boris that fits his clue ("He was sitting in a chair in the Principal's Office."). So Boris (B) must be at row 3, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Arlo is now the only person who can still go in column 2. So Arlo (A) must be at row 5, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vera. So Vera (the victim) must be at row 4, column 5. Cross out her row and column. Clara is the only person in the Art Room with Vera, so Clara is the murderer!
